name: Tsukishima Narumi
source:
Tsukishima Narumi is the manager of the antique shop "Secundum" and [url=/c123785]Narumi Kyouka[/url]'s childhood friend. [url=/c123784]Kyousuke[/url] agrees to help her out at the antique shop in exchange for Narumi's help in getting information about the pendant he is looking for.

Narumi is a beautiful woman, but she has a selfish and arrogant queen-like personality. She doesn't like bright lights and always keeps her store in a dim environment, therefore she gives off the impression of a vampire. Interestingly enough, she owns a black cat named Hellsing.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/MISSING_PARTS_the_TANTEI_STORIES]Wikipedia[/url].]
